Frequently asked questions
Why is a Bodyworks gift card the perfect gift?

Giving the gift of wellness is more than a present, it’s a true act of care and compassion. A Bodyworks of Perdido Key gift card is the kind of gift that goes beyond the moment. It reminds your recipient they’re worth slowing down, recharging, and feeling their best.

Can I send a gift card digitally?

Yes! You can send an e-gift card instantly to your recipient's email, or your email. Click here to purchase a digital gift card.

Can I personalize the digital gift card?

Yes, add a custom message to digital gift cards during checkout on our website. Physical gift cards come with an envelope and gift card perfect for gifting.

How do I get a physical gift card?

Come into our location, 12385 Sorrento Rd. Suite D1, Pensacola, FL 32507 during our normal business hours for a physical gift card with envelope.

Hours of Operation:

Monday - Friday 9:30 am - 5:00 pm

Saturday 9:00 am - 4:00 pm or until last appointment

Do gift cards ever lose their magic?

Nope, they’re timeless! Our gift cards never expire.

How can I check the gift card balance?

Give our team a call at (850) 356-6311.

What if I lose my gift card?

No worries - we can usually look it up for you. Just give us a call and we’ll be happy to help. Contact us at (850) 356-6311 or email bodyworksofperdido@gmail.com with the purchase details.

Can I get a refund for a gift card?

Gift cards are not redeemable or refundable for cash unless required by Florida law.

Who can use a gift card?

Anyone you’d like to treat! Our gift cards are fully shareable or transferable, so if spa time isn’t their thing, they can pass it along to a family member or friend.

What if my service costs more than the gift card balance?

No problem! You would just be responsible to cover the remainder of the service cost with another payment method.

Can I use the gift card towards products?

Absolutely. Gift cards can be redeemed for both services and retail products in the spa.

Do I need to let you know if I’m paying with a gift card?

Yes, please mention your gift card at checkout so our team can apply it toward your service or purchase.

Why do I need a credit card to book a service with a gift card?

We ask for a credit card to secure every appointment, even if you’re paying with a gift card. Your gift card will be used for your services, and the credit card will hold your appointment reservation. It would only ever be charged in the rare case of a no-show or not cancelled within the 24 hour cancellation window. This helps us honor every guest’s time and keep our schedule flowing smoothly.

Our Massage Services
MASSAGE
MASSAGE ENHANCEMENTS
CBD BODYWORK

All massage services at Bodyworks of Perdido Key are designed to elevate your experience with several thoughtful included optional enhancements to ensure a truly holistic and elevated massage experience:

Aromatherapy blend to engage your senses 

Warmed herbal neck pillow to ease tension

Hot towels for the back and feet to enhance relaxation

Organic warmed massage oil to nourish the skin

Chilled herbal eye pillow to rejuvenate tired eye 

Facial mist to refresh your skin and energy

MASSAGES
BALANCED WELLNESS

The art of swedish and deep tissue techniques, with your provider's unique massage blend, converge to create a harmonious and deeply rejuvenating experience, truly individualized for each person’s body. The combination of soothing strokes of swedish massage with the therapeutic intensity of deep tissue massage will melt away stress and anxiety, leaving you feeling calm and centered. While muscle tension relief with deep tissue will target deep muscle layers to alleviate chronic pain and tension, enhancing flexibility and movement.




60 Minutes | $115

90 Minutes | $160





RELAXATION

This soothing massage uses gentle, flowing Swedish massage strokes to promote deep relaxation. Beneficial for gently working out minor aches and tightness, relieving everyday stress, and boosting overall well-being without the intensity of deeper pressure.




60 Minutes | $100

90 Minutes | $145



NATURE'S HEALING REMEDY

Immerse yourself in the restorative embrace of nature with our Nature’s Healing Remedy Massage. This deeply therapeutic treatment harnesses the power of potent botanicals like arnica and stone crop, combined with the soothing warmth of basalt stones, to deliver a natural healing experience. Arnica, known for its anti-inflammatory and muscle-soothing properties, works to alleviate tension and discomfort, while stone crop, a healing succulent, deeply hydrates and revitalizes your skin. As warm stones are used to melt away stress and enhance the absorption of these healing botanicals, leaving you feeling balanced and thoroughly nurtured by the best that nature has to offer.




60 Minutes | $135

90 Minutes | $180





DEEP RELIEF

Experience profound healing with our Deep Relief Massage. This treatment targets deep muscle layers to alleviate chronic tension and pain. Our skilled massage therapists use precise and intentional techniques to release tight knots, improve circulation, and restore your body’s natural balance.




This massage penetrates deeply to provide lasting relief and revitalization, perfect for those suffering from persistent aches.




Embrace the journey towards true healing and discover the powerful benefits of our Deep Relief Massage, and let us help you reclaim comfort and mobility, leaving you feeling invigorated and restored.




60 Minutes | $120

90 Minutes | $165





RECOVERY ESSENTIALS

It is a therapeutic experience for those seeking relief from muscle tension and soreness. This customized session incorporates a blend of myofascial, deep tissue, stretching, and pressure point therapy, addressing chronic pain and stress areas. To enhance the healing process, we apply hot or cold packs if necessary and incorporate cupping therapy using high-potency Arnica oil, known for its powerful anti-inflammatory and muscle-soothing properties. Truly, these are the essentials to supporting muscle recovery and restoring your body’s natural balance and wellness.

60 Minutes | $135

90 Minutes | $180





CBD CHRONIC GOLD IMMERSION

Discover the healing power of our all-natural, high-potency CBD experience for those seeking highly-elevated therapeutic relief. Created to support active, healthy lifestyles and soothe the most severe exercise induced body aches, pain, muscle soreness, and inflammation.




Your journey begins with an optional CBD gummy to prepare your body for total relaxation. Starting with a blend of one of the most potent CBD muscle & Joint topicals on the market, your therapist will apply it to your trouble areas and along the spine, followed by a hot compress to penetrate the muscles deeply. Pain will begin to fade with a full body massage using our CBD-infused massage oil to ease tension, soothe sore muscles, and help achieve optimal, holistic recovery. To enhance your experience, we treat your hands and feet with a rich CBD skin salve, deeply moisturizing your skin.




As a special treat, you’ll take home the remainder of the 5ml tin of CBD skin salve, allowing you to extend the benefits of this golden experience long after your visit.




60 Minutes | $150

90 Minutes | $195







PRENATAL PEACE

This nurturing treatment provides gentle relief and deep relaxation. It was custom-designed for expectant mothers to help reduce pain, improve circulation, decrease swelling, alleviate pregnancy muscle tension and tightness, and promote overall well-being for you and your baby.




Our Licensed Massage Therapists have completed additional training and certification in Prenatal Massage. They use safe techniques tailored to the unique needs of pregnancy, ensuring both baby and mother are comfortable and relaxed.




Feel rejuvenated, supported, and beautifully relaxed as you prepare for the arrival of your little one. Enjoy an added treat with a complimentary mini ice cream cone after your massage.




60 Minutes | $120

90 Minutes | $165

Share the experience of a massage side by side. Whether you're celebrating a special day or spending some much-needed time together, our couples massage lets you both relax with a customized massage and enjoy a peaceful moment made just for the two of you.




All couple services must be booked by phone or in-person to

ensure availability.




60 Minutes | Pricing varies based on massage selected

90 Minutes | Pricing varies based on massage selected

$10 surcharge per person for couples room experience

30 Minutes | $65

Arnica Pain Relief Massage Oil

UNIQUE EXPERTISE AND ADVANCED SPECIALTIES TO
ENHANCE YOUR WELLNESS JOURNEY.

PROVIDER SPECIALTIES
ASHIATSU BAREFOOT MASSAGE - FULL BODY BAREFOOT EXPERIENCE

In this full-body experience rooted in flow and balance, your Licensed Massage Therapist uses their feet and body weight to deliver deep, steady pressure across your muscles for deep tension relief. It is best suited for those who love deeper bodywork, athletes, or anyone needing profound muscular relief.

ASHIATSU BAREFOOT BLEND

The best of both worlds. Your Licensed Massage Therapist combines their hands and feet to deliver the perfect balance of traditional massage and deep, grounded barefoot pressure. This is ideal for those who love the feel of hands-on massage therapy but want to add a little extra SOLE, strength, and depth to their massage experience.




60 Minutes | $130

MYOSKELETAL ALIGNMENT TECHNIQUE

The Myoskeletal Alignment Technique (MAT) system brings together the most advanced therapeutic strategies to relieve, and ultimately correct, patterns in the body that lead to pain and deterioration. MAT helps remove pain and restore comfortable function, using guided stretches and therapeutic touch. By offering assistance to the body’s natural healing process, the myoskeletal alignment techniques are designed to holistically help the body’s muscles and joints.




60 Minutes | $130

90 Minutes | $175

MANUAL LYMPHATIC DRAINAGE

The skillful manipulation of the body’s lymphatic system to stimulate it to function more efficiently. Using a series of light rhythmic movements that are applied along with compression, stretches, and cupping motions all over the body. It is intended to increase rhythmic contractions of lymphatics to reroute stagnant lymph fluid to intact nodes then eliminated.A powerful and natural way to cleanse tissues of the body after an illness or injury. MLD is performed on dry skin without lubrication.

The warmth of herbal - infused towels placed over the forehead and chest using our therapeutic respiratory essential oil blend will allow you to breathe deeply. Sink into deep relaxation as our calming blend of clary sage oil, olive oil, sage leaf extract, and ylang ylang works to balance and nourish your scalp. At Bodyworks of Perdido Key facial customization is a cornerstone of our spa experience. By customizing every aspect of your skin care treatment - from the products used to the techniques applies - we ensure that you leave our space with radiant, healthy skin and a renewed sense of well-being.​

EMPOWERED CUSTOMIZATION,

ENSURING YOUR SKIN ALWAYS RECEIVES OPTIMAL CARE​

​

Our skincare treatments offers a clearer path to healthier, happier skin by offering:

Enhanced product efficacy • Incorporating the latest advancements • Enhanced customization • Seasonal adjustments • Targeted treatments • Holistic wellness approach • Preventative skin care • Continuous skin evolution

The foundation of each facial includes the face and neck with:

Eminence Organic Skin Care

Eminence Organic Skin Care products are hand-picked made with fresh fruit pulps, plants and exotic spices. This makes them incredibly rich in nutrients, so they are not only the healthiest choice for you, but also the most effective, results-oriented collection around.

 

Vitamins are captured in their all-natural fresh base, offering dramatic results as actual seeds, pulps and peels impart regenerative and healing powers that only nature can produce.

 

The precious ingredients are combined with thermal hot spring water to create products that contain potent healing and beautifying properties. Choosing organic ingredients ensures that there are no harsh chemicals added. Eminence products do not contain harmful chemicals like added Parabens, Petrolatum, Mineral Oils, Propylene Glycol or Sodium Lauryl Sulfate.

Each product used in your treatment will be selected based on your skin care needs and goals.

 

Your Licensed Esthetician will tailor your skin care treatment with personalized options, which may include LED Light Therapy and High Frequency. Each treatment customization is designed to maximize your results and ensure the most beneficial experience during your visit.

​

We're all about creating personalized skincare experiences that are thoughtfully crafted just for you. ​

Alongside our recommendations, you’ll be introduced to professional skin care treatments and potent organic products, each selected in alignment with your skin’s chemistry. Together we can define your skin care goals.




Step into our space where each treatment is an act of self-love, empowering you to embrace your natural beauty with confidence.

The Dermaplane Facial at Bodyworks is more than just a beauty exfoliation; it's a holistic skin rejuvenation experience that nurtures your soul and brings out an inner glow that matches your newly revitalized skin.

This elevated dermaplane will remove peach fuzz and the top layer of dead skin cells, giving your skin the perfect foundation to maximize the results of our professional peel treatments.




Infused into the newly refreshed skin, our professional peels energize cell turnover, boost collagen for firmness, minimize pores, reduce fine lines, and reveal a more vibrant glow.




Following the peel, we soothe and calm the skin with an intensive cooling treatment infused with menthol and rose hip. This unique combination provides an immediate calming effect, reducing redness and inflammation. The menthol offers a refreshing, cooling sensation, while the rosehip, rich in essential fatty acids and antioxidants, deeply nourishes and hydrates your skin.

CBD FAQ
What is CBD?

CBD or cannabidiol is a non-intoxicating, non-psychoactive compound found in the cannabis and hemp plant. It is the most prevalent compound found in the hemp plant and second in the cannabis plant.


Why Hemp VS Cannabis?

The hemp plant is richer in CBD percentages and can test upwards of 15% CBD, while maintaining a THC level of less than .3%. The hemp plant is considered hemp when it tests and contains less than .3% THC. The hemp plant is legal on the federal level. Hemp is also rich in amino acids and omega fatty acids. The fibers of hemp can also be used in many commercial and industrial products like paper, building materials, compost and clothes. The whole hemp plant is used throughout the process. The cannabis plant is rich in THC, and can test in upwards of 30% THC, while containing much less CBD than its hemp counterpart, usually in the 1-5% range and is federally illegal to grow and possess.

What is CBD Isolate?

Isolate CBD is the purest form of CBD available, testing around 99.99% CBD and can be found in both crystalline and powdered crystal form. Isolate contains only one cannabinoid, CBD. Isolate is made through a 3-step extraction process in order to get the CBD isolated to its purest form.

What in the world is a Cannabinoid?

A Cannabinoid is a diverse classification of the many active chemical compounds found in the Hemp and Cannabis Plants. These compounds can be nonphysocactive (CBD) and Psychoactive (THC). The Hemp and Cannabis Plants can contain over 100 different cannabinoid compounds. These “cannabinoids” are more popularly known as CBD, CBG, CBN, CBC, and THC, just to name a few.

Where does our Hemp & CBD come from?

Our Hemp CBD products are derived right n Colorado. The hemp is grown under the Colorado sun by local farmers who ensure a pure product. The hemp is also extracted in Colorado and those extracts are then used in small batch, handmade hemp CBD products. These products are a true full circle product supporting an array of local USA small businesses.

What does CBD do to you?

CBD can support both the body and mind in a variety of ways. Most common benefits include relieving exercise-induced body aches, pains, muscle soreness and inflammation, supporting a calming sense of relaxation, focus and balance, promoting healthy sleep cycles, and helping to manage work and life-induce stress.




What is Full Spectrum CBD?

Full Spectrum CBD is an oil rich in CBD but also contains low levels of other cannabinoids such as CBG, CBN, CBC and THC. It contains all the beneficial compounds from the hemp plant, including naturally-occurring terpenes, essential vitamins, fatty acids and proteins. Full Spectrum CBD may have a more synergistic effect than pure CBD isolate, which is often referred to as the ‘entourage effect’. Full Spectrum Oil usually tests at around 75%-90% CBD and must test at less than .3% THC. Full Spectrum Oil is extracted by a 2-step process.

Does CBD get you high?

The short answer is no; CBD won’t get you high. THC is the psychoactive compound in the cannabis plant that creates the feeling of being “high.” As discussed above, all of our full spectrum products contain less than .3% THC and our isolate products are 99.99% pure CBD. While both CBD and THC interact with the endocannabinoid system, they are completely different chemical compounds. THC acts on CB1 receptors in the brain to produce an intoxicating effect, while CBD doesn’t directly interact with any receptors that cause that sensation.


What is the entourage effect?

Some research has found that when CBD and THC are used together, they produce what's known as the entourage effect. This means that when used together, they may be more effective than either cannabinoid used alone.

Will I pass a drug test?

There is always a risk of failing a drug test, and if you are concerned with this we recommend using our isolate products. Our Isolate CBD products contain 0% THC. The CBD isolate we use here at Lost Range is tested at 99.99% CBD. Our Full Spectrum CBD products contain less than .3% THC and contains other cannabinoids such as CBD, CBG and CBC.

What is the extraction process for CBD?

Bulk CBD is sourced from Hotchkiss Colorado from a close business partner of ours who has been in the CBD farming business since legalization. All of the hemp is grown in that surrounding area using organic practices by a Co-Op of farmers who have small operations (100 acres or less). The majority of our hemp’s journey starts in greenhouses as seed or clones, and is then planted, by hand, into the fields.

When the hemp is ready for harvest, it goes through a rigorous 3rd-party testing process outlined by Colorado state law. This testing process or “panel”, checks for potency, molds, microbials, mycotoxins, heavy metals, pesticides and moisture. The hemp is tested pre-harvest and post-harvest. The hemp must pass the state testing panel or it will be destroyed and disposed of.

The extraction process used for the CBD Distillate and Isolate* is what is referred to as “Cold Ethanol Extraction”. All the equipment used in this process is made in the USA and is hand-fabricated stainless steel ‘stamp’ certified by Federal, State and Local officials. Throughout the process of extraction and refinement, these systems are what's called a “closed loop” system. Meaning each stage is performed in a closed loop where the material and solvents (i.e. ethanol) are never exposed to the atmosphere until the solvent is fully recovered to be used again.

The first process is what is referred to as the soak or wash, in which the hemp is washed in a pure and cold ethanol (between -40 to -50C) in a machine much like a big commercial washing machine. The cold ethanol helps extract the beneficial elements from the plant like cannabinoids and terpenes while leaving behind unwanted materials like lipids (fats) and chlorophyll. After the extraction or wash is complete, it is spun in the machine allowing the ethanol to be moved into a separate vessel for the 2nd step. This allows for the spent hemp to be virtually dry and free of ethanol solvent. Once this step is complete, the hemp is distributed into a large tote to air dry where it is then used by others for compost, mulch, animal feed, fertilizer or other uses/practices. This system has a solvent recovery rate of 99%+ depending on the system and operator.

The second process is the recovery of the ethanol. The ethanol - while still under a vacuum and closed looped system - is then ready to be recovered and separated from the oils that were extracted. This process is used by means of a “falling film evaporator”. In basic terms, the ethanol is poured over heat in a vessel which turns the ethanol into a vapor where it is then cooled and collected back as a liquid in a separate vessel. This separates the cannabinoid oils and terpenes from the ethanol and allows for the ethanol to be re-collected to be repeatedly used for further extractions. The result of this process is what is called “crude cannabinoid oil”. These systems have a reconversion rate of 97-99%+ depending on the system used and the operator. Great quick basic video of how this work: How Falling Film Evaporator Works

Step three is the Decarboxylation and degassing of the crude oil. This process involves heating the crude oil to release carbon dioxide and any remaining solvents from the oil. This helps purify the oil while also activating the cannabinoids. This activation is a crucial step as it makes the oils clean, effective, psychoactive, and potent.

Step four in the process is refinement of the crude oil. The crude oil will now move on to the distillation process and into a wipe film distillation machine. This will refine the oil of impurities while making the oil more potent. This refinement basically removes unwanted oils turning it into a high grade Distillate referred to as Full Spectrum Oil*(or Distillate). This oil is now a gold to light yellow oil in appearance and will have a potency of 70-90+% CBD. It will also have trace amounts of other cannabinoids such as THC, CBG, CBN, CBDA and more.

Step five in the process is further refinement of the Distillitate or Full-spectrum oil by transforming it into an Isolate which is a pharmaceutical grade oil/crystal. In this refinement, you are “isolating” a cannabinoid from the oil to obtain a 99.99% pure product, in this case CBD. This stage requires the distillate oil to be placed in a reactor and washed with Pentane. Under pressure and extreme cold temperatures, the Pentane causes a chemical reaction and allows for the CBD to crystallize and separate from the rest of the oils. Once this is complete the Pentane is cycled back to a holding tank to be used again which is often called the “Mother Liquor”. The end result is a crystal that has a fine powder consistency, is 99.99% pure and is known as CBD Isolate.

Step six is the Isolate powder is then moved into a vacuum oven which puts the powder on low heat and vacuum. This process further purges any remaining solvents in the crystal and readies it for infusion into products. CBD isolate is the pharmaceutical grade of CBD and should have a potency test of 99.99% purity.

It’s important to note that before the Distillate/Full Spectrum Oil or Isolate is sold or distributed, it goes through the same rigorous testing panel the hemp did for potency, molds, microbials, mycotoxins, heavy metals, pesticides and moisture. This ensures that the products are safe to consume and adhere to State and Federal regulations.

Lab Society is another great resource for further learning the processes in a more scientific manner. There is a header at the top that explains the full cycle. Please note there are many different ways to complete this process including many different machines and apparatuses to get to the final product. Initial Cannabis & Hemp Extraction Process

*Full Spectrum Oil (or Distillate) - Full Spectrum CBD is an oil rich in CBD but also contains low levels of other cannabinoids such as CBG, CBN, CBC and THC. It contains all the beneficial compounds from the hemp plant, including naturally-occurring terpenes, essential vitamins, fatty acids and proteins. Full Spectrum CBD may have a more synergistic effect

than pure CBD isolate, which is often referred to as the ‘entourage effect’. Full Spectrum Oil usually tests at around 75%-90% CBD and must test at less than .3% THC.

*Isolate- Isolate CBD is the purest form of CBD available, pharmaceutical grade and testing at 99.99% CBD and can be found in both crystalline and powdered crystal form. Isolate contains only one cannabinoid, CBD.

Our Team

At Bodyworks of Perdido Key, our team thrives on positivity and mutual support. We foster an uplifting environment where everyone is encouraged to grow, feel valued, and share in our collective mission of creating exceptional experiences for our guests. Together, we build each other up, ensuring our team's well-being is always a priority.

​

This strong sense of community within our team reflects in everything we do, allowing us to provide the best care for our guests. When we feel supported as a team, it shines through in the exceptional service and warm environment we create everyday at Bodyworks. 

Cindy

Founder

Cindy Rodriguez, the visionary behind Bodyworks of Perdido Key, began her massage therapy career in 2004. She embraced opportunities to learn from all aspects of the healing world, gaining experience with chiropractors, day spas, and military wellness centers abroad. She continuously expanded her bodywork knowledge by specializing in therapies such as Thai Yoga Massage, Orthopedic, Neuromuscular, Aromatherapy, Cupping, Prenatal, Hot Stone, Sarga Silks, and Deep Tissue. However, Ashiatsu Barefoot Massage captured her heart, leading her to complete all advanced training and eventually teach the practice. Those who experienced Cindy’s "sole-ful" practice know the incredible care, attention to detail, and flow she infused into every session. This diverse background shaped her approach to wellness and helped her fully envision what we know today as Bodyworks of Perdido Key. Creating Bodyworks of Perdido Key in 2013 with a single-room massage studio and a powerful dream of bringing wellness to her community. With determination and a deep commitment to unreasonable hospitality, Cindy nurtured her business from the ground up, building a loyal massage clientele who embraced her vision of healing and compassion. Over time, her dreams of expanding into a full-service spa became a reality as Bodyworks grew to offer massage, skincare, and wellness services. Cindy’s unwavering commitment to ensuring that every guest receives exceptional care is at the heart of Bodyworks of Perdido Key. Her focus on creating meaningful, healing experiences for each guest is reflected in the spa's atmosphere and the outstanding service provided by her dedicated team. Cindy believes every guest deserves to feel nurtured and supported, and she works continuously to ensure Bodyworks is a place where kindness, care, and holistic wellness are central to the experience. Cindy’s goal has always been to create a space where her team and guests feel seen, heard, and cared for. She is always eager to learn and stay current with business trends and culture. Her most recent accomplishment was completing her Social Media Marketing Certification with Cornell University, further enhancing her expertise to lead and grow. Through her leadership, the spa has become a place where community, wellness, and kindness come together. Cindy enjoys hiking, and her favorite place in the world is Telluride, Colorado, where she finds a sense of peace and renewal, offering the perfect balance between her busy life as a mother and business owner and her love for adventure and exploration. With a heart full of love and determination, Bodyworks of Perdido stands as a testament to Cindy's devotion to continuing to make a positive impact and contribute to a better, more caring world. Rosie

Spa Coordinator

Rosie Hurd, our kind and dedicated Spa Coordinator, is a proud graduate of West Florida High School and a current student at Pensacola State College, where she will soon earn her Associates of Art degree. Passionate about continuing her education, Rosie will pursue a degree in psychology at the University of West Florida. Her goal is to deepen her understanding of mental health and make a meaningful impact by helping those in need. With a background in customer service, Rosie's caring and compassionate nature shines through in everything she does. She loves connecting with both guests and team members at Bodyworks, always contributing to their day with kindness and a warm smile. As a Spa Coordinator, Rosie is dedicated to ensuring every guest and team member feels welcome and well cared for. Her accomplishments in education and dedication to everything she does make her family incredibly proud. As the oldest of six siblings, Rosie's nurturing spirit comes naturally. She has a big heart for animals, reuniting lost pets with their families and fostering those in need of love and care. Rosie also donates supplies to local shelters and is excited to soon begin volunteering at the Pensacola Humane Society, furthering her commitment to making a difference in the lives of animals. In her free time, Rosie enjoys reading - Twilght is her favorite series - and is a devoted Taylor Swift fan.

Marie

Licensed Massage Therapist

Marie has been practicing massage therapy since 2013, and she has a deep passion for helping others through therapeutic bodywork. Specializing in Deep Tissue massage, particularly for athletes and weight lifters, she brings a strong, restorative approach to addressing muscle tension and promoting recovery. Marie also excels in Prenatal massage, Reflexology, anxiety relief, migraine management, stretching, and hot stone therapy. Her interest in the medical field led her to explore oncology massage, which has become one of her future goals. With numerous continuing education classes in oncology massage, including a significant 3-day training at Long Beach Children’s Hospital for Pediatric Oncology, she remains dedicated to offering compassionate care for those in need. Marie is passionate about expanding her expertise in oncology massage and looks forward to focusing on additional specialized training as her children get older. Her dedication to providing compassionate care is at the heart of all she does, and she is excited to deepen her knowledge when the time is right Marie’s journey into massage therapy began in childhood when she was often praised for her natural talent in giving massages. This encouragement pushed her to pursue massage therapy as a career. During her training, she received daily Deep Tissue massages and noticed firsthand the benefits of bodywork, which solidified her commitment to the field. Having personally dealt with sciatica and carpal tunnel syndrome during her second pregnancy, Marie understands the challenges of chronic pain and is especially empathetic to clients with similar conditions. Outside of work, Marie is a dedicated mom who volunteers at her children’s schools and enjoys traveling with her family to explore new cultures. A true foodie at heart, she’s always looking for the next best place to try. Marie’s holistic approach, rooted in her personal experiences and professional training, makes her a compassionate and effective therapist eager to help others on their journey to wellness. Florida License: MA87393 Continuing Education: Manual Lymphatic Drainage Massage for Cancer Incorporating Manual Lymphatic Drainage Prenatal Massage Active Assisted Full Body Stretching Reflexology Hot Stone Massage Cupping Therapy Cancer & Massage Therapy Anxiety Disorders & Massage Low Back Pain & Massage

Joe

Licensed Massage Therapist

Joe’s career is rooted in his lifelong passion for helping others. Practicing massage since 2016, he transitioned from a full-time career as a social worker with at-risk children to massage therapy, continuing his mission to bring healing and support to those in need. With specialized training in Swedish, Deep Tissue, Trigger Point, Sports, Oncology, Prenatal, Cupping Therapy, Hot Stone, Decompression, Abdominal, Seated Ashiatsu, Reflexology, and as a Reiki Master, Joe is a versatile therapist dedicated to providing personalized, holistic care. Joe has had the valuable experience of working alongside a chiropractor, which has greatly expanded his knowledge and understanding of the body’s musculoskeletal system. He has honed his ability to address specific issues related to the shoulders, neck, and lower back, helping clients find relief from pain. Life’s experiences have always inspired Joe to grow and learn. When a close family member was diagnosed with breast cancer, he pursued oncology massage to help others in similar situations. After the birth of his son, he became skilled in prenatal massage, and most recently, following a hand injury, he took that time to learn Ashiatsu Barefoot Massage, allowing him to continue his work through creative adaptation. Outside of massage, Joe is deeply devoted to caring for his family. He balances his passion for healing with his commitment to creating a nurturing and supportive environment at home. His experiences with his family continuously inspire him in his work, driving him to approach each client with the same care and compassion he brings to his own loved ones. He finds solace in the peaceful moments of fishing, playing the saxophone, and listening to jazz piano. Joe’s future goals include expanding his holistic skills and integrating his social work background with massage therapy to help those in need, possibly by teaching ethics within the field. He also looks forward to deepening his expertise in Ashiatsu Barefoot Massage, always driven by a desire to improve and provide compassionate care. Florida License: MA95583 Continuing Education: Swedish Deep Tissue Trigger Point Sports Oncology Prenatal Cupping Therapy Hot Stone Decompression Abdominal Seated Ashiatsu Reflexology Reiki Master

Autumn

Licensed Esthetician

Autumn began her journey in esthetics in 2019 after starting in the makeup industry, where she quickly realized the importance of healthy skin as a foundation. Her passion shifted from covering up imperfections to prioritizing skin health, and she’s been dedicated to providing her community with healthy skincare options ever since. Autumn joined Bodyworks right out of esthetics school and has grown significantly into a remarkably skilled and compassionate professional. Driven and passionate, Autumn has already achieved significant milestones in her career, including opening Reflections @ Riesberg Institute and further expanding her offering at Bodyworks of Perdido Key to offer a unique blend of medical aesthetics while maintaining a holistic, natural approach. She believes in combining the best of both worlds—providing a nurturing, relaxing experience while recognizing some guests may seek more advanced treatments, and Autumn is fully equipped to meet both needs. Recognized as one of VIP Magazine’s Leading Ladies in 2023 and 2024, Autumn continues to push boundaries in the field of esthetics. Her specialized training includes Dermaplane Pro, Nufree Hair Removal, Skin for Life Pure O2, Bella Lash & Brow, Hydrafacial, and ongoing education with Eminence Organic Skin Care, while her medical aesthetic expertise spans extensive clinical training with Inmode for IPL, RF microneedling, Spider Vein treatments, Emsculpt NEO, Softwave, and various medical grade skin care lines. Autumn excels in customizing holistic skincare treatments, seamlessly integrating minimally invasive medical techniques for glowing, healthy skin. Her calming, angelic approach allows her to fully focus on each client, leaving them deeply relaxed and radiant. Beyond her practice, Autumn is actively involved in the community, contributing to organizations such as Impact 100, Pensacola Junior League, Capstone, Pensacola Opera, and participating in numerous events with Bodyworks of Perdido Key. One of her favorite events being the Perdido Beach Resort Half Marathon, supporting the Jennifer Claire Moore Foundation where she ran side by side with her Bodyworks team. In her free time, Autumn enjoys local live music, reading and rebinding books, and soaking up the sun at the beach whenever she can. Brooke

Spa Manager

Brooke is a shining example of warmth and dedication. With true southern charm and a heart for service, she brings warmth and dedication to her role. A former catering chef with degrees in Culinary Arts, Hospitality Management, and a Bachelor's in Business Marketing, she blends her love for hospitality and excellence in everything she does. Her unwavering commitment to excellence and genuine care for every guest make her an invaluable leader. Brooke ensures that each person who walks through our doors receives exceptional service and leaves feeling cared for and pampered. She is dedicated to making sure each guest feels like they’re in the best hands. Her goal is to ensure that every question is answered, and she always goes the extra mile to ask, “What else can I do for you?” Her kindness, attention to detail, and desire to give her best to each person define her approach to guest care. Beyond her role in managing daily operations, Brooke is a mentor and support system for the team, fostering a positive and nurturing work environment. Her strong ties to the community and passion for building meaningful connections make her an irreplaceable part of Bodyworks. She’s not only a leader in the spa but also a beloved member of the Perdido Key community, always striving to uplift those around her with her kindness and professionalism. Whether she’s connecting with spa partners, guests, or her team, Brooke’s joyful spirit and genuine love for people come through in everything she does, ensuring every experience is filled with authentic hospitality and care. Brooke’s heart lies not only in her role as Spa Manager at Bodyworks of Perdido Key but also in her love for life’s simple joys. A devoted Jimmy Buffett fan - Parrothead, she embraces the laid-back, island-inspired vibe his music brings. When she’s not ensuring the spa runs smoothly, Brooke can be found spending time with her family, gardening, and cooking.

Ella

Spa Team Support

Ella serves as Spa Team Support at Bodyworks, assisting with daily operations and helping ensure every guest experience feels seamless and intentional. Currently a high school senior, Ella plans to pursue a degree in psychology and has been actively involved in volleyball, soccer, and tennis. Her commitment to both academics and athletics reflects the dedication and teamwork she brings to the spa each day.

Meagan

Licensed Massage Therapist

Meagan’s passion for massage therapy is as vibrant as her personality and career. As a former massage educator, she found immense joy in sharing her knowledge with aspiring therapists, guiding them toward success in the field. Now, she enjoys working alongside other skilled therapists, constantly inspired by the collaborative environment that fosters growth and excellence. Practicing massage since 2010, she has acquired specialized training in Myoskeletal Alignment Therapy, Orthopedic, Myofascial Release, Deep Tissue, Neuromuscular, Prenatal, Cupping Therapy, Bamboo, Sports, Hot Stone, and Swedish techniques, Meagan focuses on pain management, and working with athletes while incorporating soothing relaxation methods. Meagan’s journey into massage began in childhood, when she witnessed firsthand the profound difference that natural bodywork could make. Having personally experienced the healing power of massage after her own medical procedures, including abdominal and heart surgery, as well as recovery from an auto accident. These experiences gave her a deep understanding of the physical and emotional challenges that come with healing. Massage played a crucial role in her recovery, helping to reduce pain, promote mobility, breaking down scar tissue, and restore balance in her body. Meagan’s personal experiences with her own healing journey allow her to connect deeply with her massage guests. With a heart full of empathy for the emotional side of recovery and a deep understanding of the body, she combines compassion with expertise to guide her clients through their own healing process. Meagan plans to deepen her expertise in Myoskeletal Alignment Therapy and Orthopedics, ensuring she stays at the forefront of pain management techniques. She also has her sights set on training in Ashiatsu Barefoot Massage to expand her skill set even more. Outside the massage room, Meagan is a devoted mom who loves to read and run. Her dedication extends to the running community, where she has participated in several massage events for runners before and after marathons. Her community outreach inspired her to not only help runners, but to run alongside them. Meagan is dedicated to continuing her ½ marathon training, with goals of going even further. Lesley

Licensed Massage Therapist

Lesley’s journey into massage therapy began in 2015 with a deep appreciation for balance and patience, much like the practice of yoga, which she loves. Early in her massage career, she spent two years working alongside chiropractors, learning how to support the body’s healing process. From there, she transitioned to the serene setting of day spas, where she refined her approach to relaxation and restoration. With specialized training in manual lymphatic drainage, reflexology, prenatal massage, and Thai bodywork, Lesley’s touch is both calming and rejuvenating. Her massage technique is rooted in the belief that, like yoga, massage brings balance to the body and mind, helping clients feel grounded and restored. Lesley also embraces a mindful approach to life outside of her work. Inspired by the principles of “Leave No Trace,” she participates in litter pickup initiatives throughout the Pensacola area, always aiming to leave her community better than she found it. In her free time, she enjoys the quiet joy of reading, the meditative flow of yoga, and the vibrancy of live concerts. Looking ahead, Lesley is eager to strengthen her skills in manual lymphatic drainage and incorporate more Thai massage techniques into her practice. She’s also deeply drawn to Ayurvedic therapies and looks forward to exploring their healing power through natural approaches to all aspects of health and well-being. Jonina

Licensed Esthetician

Jonina brings over 16 years of skincare and esthetics expertise to Bodyworks of Perdido Key. Originally from Iceland, a land known for its natural beauty, Jonina has embodied this spirit in her approach to skincare, blending the purity and simplicity of nature with her treatments. Her philosophy emphasizes the importance of holistic wellness, where the health of the skin reflects the care and balance we bring to our lives. This deep connection to her Icelandic roots inspires her to offer treatments that nurture not just the skin, but the overall well-being of her clients, helping them feel restored and radiant from the inside out. Her journey into skincare began in 2007 after an unforgettable first facial, where she fell in love with the art of skincare and the power of touch. Jonina studied at Cheeks International in Fort Collins, Colorado, and soon found herself mastering a wide range of techniques, from HydraFacials to dermaplaning, chemical peels, and more. With specialized training in various skin treatments and product knowledge spanning top brands like Eminence and Dermalogica, Jonina has dedicated herself to helping her clients maintain healthy, glowing skin. Though she no longer practices permanent makeup or lash extensions, Jonina is proud of her time running her own business, where she enjoyed helping others feel and look their best. Now, she focuses on treating mature and aging skin, a passion that stems from her desire to help women embrace their natural beauty at every stage of life. Her background as a personal fitness trainer has also given her a deep understanding of how lifestyle factors like stress and nutrition impact overall health, including the skin. Beyond the treatment room, Jonina is committed to giving back to her community, volunteering weekly at the Health & Hope Clinic, where she helps those without health insurance access quality care. Currently completing her prerequisites to become a physician assistant, she aspires to continue blending her passion for skincare with her medical ambitions. When she’s not working or studying, you can find Jonina enjoying strength training, hot yoga, or preparing for her next big challenge—a sprint triathlon. With her Icelandic roots and heart for service, Jonina is dedicated to making sure each of her clients leaves feeling renewed and radiant. To ensure you secure your preferred date and time, we highly recommend booking your appointment as far in advance as possible. A valid credit card is required to hold all reservations at the time of booking.

Intake Forms:

​We require intake forms for all guests to ensure that we have a complete understanding of your health history, preferences, and any specific needs or concerns before your treatment.  

​

Advanced Aesthetics Best Practices:

For your comfort and safety, we kindly ask that you wait at least 48 hours after receiving advanced aesthetic treatments (such as injectables, microneedling, chemical peels, or laser services) before scheduling a massage or facial service with us. This short window allows your skin and body the proper time to recover, ensuring you get the most benefit and best results from your experience. If you're unsure of the proper wait time, please check with your medical provider before booking. 

​

Why Are Intake Forms Required?

​As a spa establishment licensed with the Florida Department of Health and the Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulations, we adhere to the highest standards of care. Our intake forms ensure that we have all the necessary health information to provide treatments that are not only therapeutic but also safe for you. Whether it's something simple like avoiding an ingredient due to allergies or making adjustments for more complex medical concerns, this information allows us to create a personalized experience while ensuring your well-being. 

 

Since life and health can change, we require an updated form every 12 months. This keeps your provider informed on any new injuries or health updates, allowing us to tailor treatments to your current needs. Our goal is to ensure our care evolves with you, providing safe and personalized care every time. 

​

Arrival Time:

​If this is your first visit with us, we recommend that you arrive at least 5 - 10 minutes prior to your first scheduled appointment. This will allow ample time for you and your provider to discuss your personal needs and expectations for your services and for you to begin relaxing and enjoying your time with us.

 

Late Arrival:

​We understand that life can sometimes run off schedule. If you arrive late, we will do our best to accommodate you. However, please be aware that arriving late may result in a shortened service time in order to respect the schedules of other guests. Full service fees will still apply. 

 

In the event of being beyond 15 minutes late, we may need to reschedule your appointment, subject to availability, and our cancellation policy will apply.

 

By following this policy, we can ensure that you receive the full benefit of your service, and our team can maintain a smooth schedule for all guests. 

 

Cancellation Policy

 

24-Hour Cancellation Requirement:

​We respectfully request a minimum of 24 hours’ notice if you need to cancel or reschedule your appointment.  This courtesy gives us the opportunity to fill your spot and maintain availability for others. Failure to provide at least  24 hours’ notice will result in an automatic charge of 50% of the reserved service total to the credit card on file. 

​

Parties of Two or More:

​For parties of two or more, we require at least 48 hours notice to cancel or reschedule. Failure to provide this notice will result in a 100% charge for all services booked for the party.

​

Special Considerations for Weekends and Holidays:

​For appointments scheduled on Fridays, Saturdays, and national holidays, cancellations made within 24 hours will be charged 100% of the service amount. These times are in high demand, and this policy helps us maintain availability for other guests during peak times. 

​

Voicemails and Emails Outside of Business Hours:

​Please note that any voicemails or emails left after spa operating hours for appointments scheduled the next day will be subject to the 50% cancellation fee. For Monday appointments, any voicemails or emails left after our business hours on Saturday will incur the same 50% fee, as we are unable to process these changes during our closure. 

​

Scheduling With a Gift Card:

​If you are using a gift card to book your appointment, the same cancellation policies apply. Any applicable cancellation or no-show fees will be deducted from your gift card balance. Please note that even with a gift card on file, a valid credit card is required to reserve your appointment.

​

No-Shows:

​Missing your appointment without notice will result in a charge of 100% of the service amount. No-shows significantly affect our ability to serve others, and we appreciate your understanding. 

 

If a guest has 2 or more no-shows, pre-payment will be required for all future appointments. Additionally, any outstanding cancellation fees must be paid before booking new services.

​

At Bodyworks of Perdido Key, our schedule is primarily by appointment, meaning that when you reserve a service, that time is set aside exclusively for you. These policies ensure that our team is fairly compensated for their time and services. They also allow us to notify standby guests of any last-minute availability and keep our schedules running smoothly, which helps us serve everyone more effectively. Our policies are essential for the success of Bodyworks of Perdido Key and the livelihood of our talented team. 

 

When you schedule your appointment with us, you are agreeing to the terms of our cancellation policy outlined above. However, we understand that life can be unpredictable, and emergencies may arise. In those moments, we ask that you reach out to us, and we will do our best to accommodate your needs with care and understanding. Our goal is always for you to be here with us, enjoying your service to the fullest. We appreciate your support in helping us maintain a smooth, stress-free experience for everyone at Bodyworks of Perdido Key. 

​

Quiet Environment:

​We strive to create a peaceful and serene environment for all our guests. To maintain this sense of calm, we kindly ask that you keep voices low and conversations soft once you enter our space. Soft voices help preserve the calm, quiet environment that enhances the healing experience.  Should we gently remind you to lower your voice during your visit, please know it’s never meant with disrespect. We have multiple services happening at the same time, and we want everyone to enjoy their peaceful experience - including you during your own treatment. It’s about creating a peaceful atmosphere for all, and your understanding helps us keep our space a relaxing haven for everyone. 

 

Cell Phones & Electronic Devices:

​We ask that all cell phones and electronic devices be silenced or turned off during your visit and you refrain from having conversations on your devices during check-in, checkout, or during your service. The use of speaker phones is not permitted anywhere inside the spa. This ensures that both you and our other guests in treatment can fully unwind and enjoy their treatments without interruptions. 

​

Personal Hygiene:

​As a small, independently owned spa, we do not have locker rooms or shower facilities on-site. To ensure the best possible experience for both you and our team, we ask that you arrive showered and clean, especially after activities like golfing, fishing, working out, or spending time at the beach. This helps us maintain a comfortable, hygienic environment for all guests.  

​

Product Use: 

​We only use spa-provided lotions, oils, gels, creams, and essential oils to maintain the highest standards for safety and sanitation. For this reason, outside products are not permitted. If you have allergies, please let us know when booking, and we can provide product ingredient lists to help you choose the best option for your needs. 

 

All our products are thoughtfully selected for their quality, many being organic, natural, sustainable, and free from harmful chemicals. We are committed to offering products that not only align with our wellness philosophy but also deliver therapeutic benefits, ensuring you feel great both inside and out. 

​

Personal Health and Wellness:

​If you are feeling unwell, experiencing symptoms of illness, or have been recently exposed to a contagious illness, we ask that you reschedule your appointment. 

​

Pet Guidelines: 

​Due to our licensing and health regulations, we are unable to accommodate your furry friends at the spa, except for certified service animals. We understand how much pets mean to you, but this policy ensures a safe and hygienic environment for all of our guests. If you have a certified service animal, please let us know in advance so we can make the proper arrangements to welcome you both comfortably.

​

Inclement Weather:

​In the event that our area is under any official weather warning or advisory, you may reschedule your appointment with no charge as long as it’s within 24 hours of your scheduled time. In addition, we extend this safety option to our team members to ensure their safe arrival and return home. Your safety and the safety of our team is our top priority.

 

Forms of Payment: 

​We accept cash, Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and Apple Pay for payments. Please note, we do not accept personal checks. 

 

Credit Card Information:

​For your security and privacy, when you provide credit card information to reserve an appointment, it is securely stored in our booking system. Only the last four digits of your card are visible to our front desk team, ensuring that your full card details remain protected. When credit card information is requested or captured, it is handled through a secure system, adhering to the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS), and we do not have access to the full card number. 

 

Gratuity:

​A gratuity is a thoughtful way to show appreciation for the care and dedication our providers put into each service. While gratuity is not included in the price of services, it is always warmly appreciated but never expected. Your generous tips go directly to your service provider, supporting their commitment to delivering exceptional experiences. 

 

For your convenience, gratuity can be added to your credit card during check out or left in the gratuity envelopes provided at the front desk. The industry standard for tipping ranges from 20 - 30%, but ultimately, we want you to feel comfortable tipping what feels right for you.

​

Returns/Refunds:

​Due to the nature of our services, all sales on treatments, gift cards, and packages are final and non-refundable. If you are dissatisfied with your service, please let us know immediately, and we will do our best to address any concerns. 

 

For retail products, we accept returns on unopened, unused items, in the original packaging within 3 days of purchase, accompanied by the original receipt. Refunds will be issued in the original form of payment. Opened or used products cannot be returned due to health and safety regulations. 

 

Prices & Services:

​Prices and services are subject to change without notice. We will do our best to keep our clients up to date on any changes that may occur, but we encourage all clients to inquire about pricing and available services when reserving their appointment. 

​

After a service is rendered, the price of the services stands; It is the client’s responsibility to know the price of his/her service(s). By receiving the service, you agree to pay the full price of that service.

 

Gift Cards:

​Gift cards are nonrefundable and cannot be redeemed for cash. Gift cards may be used towards any service or product at Bodyworks of Perdido Key.

 

When scheduling an appointment, a valid credit card is required to hold your reservation at Bodyworks of Perdido Key. This policy applies even if you intend to pay with a gift card.

 

If a gift card is purchased for a specific service or package we will honor the price for 1 year after the date purchased. After 1 year, the redeemer will be responsible for any increases. 

​

Specials & Discounts:

​Specials and discounts on services or products cannot be combined with other offers, promotions, or discounts unless specifically stated. All specials are subject to availability and may have expiration dates. Discounts apply only to the service or product specified and cannot be transferred to others services. Additionally, any changes to services booked under a special may result in a price adjustment.

 

We are proud to offer a 10% military discount to active-duty and retired military personnel, as well as first responders, including police officers, firefighters, and EMS. A valid ID must be presented at the time of service. This discount cannot be combined with any other specials, discounts, promos, or offers.

​

Child Safety:

​For the safety and comfort of all guests, children under the age of 10 are not permitted in the spa.

 

Minors Receiving Services:

​All persons between the ages of 10 - 17  receiving services at the spa are required to have a parent or legal guardian complete a Minor Release Form prior to the appointment. Additionally, the parent or guardian must remain in the treatment room for the duration of the service to ensure the comfort and safety of the minor. No other children are permitted in the treatment room during the service.

​

Smoking & Vaping:

We are a smoke-free and vape-free facility. Smoking and vaping are not permitted anywhere within our spa facility. 

 

Alcohol: 

No outside alcohol is permitted at the spa. 

​

Modesty Concerns:

​We prioritize your comfort and privacy during all treatments. It is required by law and our establishment’s policy that guests remain appropriately covered and draped at all times. Only the areas being worked on will be exposed during your service, ensuring your modesty is fully respected. 

 

Confidentiality:

​We do not disclose any information about our guests, including health history or service preferences, to third parties without your explicit consent. Any personal details shared with us, whether during your visit or through intake forms, are kept confidential and used solely for the purpose of providing you with personalized care at our spa. 

 

Professionalism:

​At Bodyworks of Perdido Key, all of our providers are professionally licensed in the state of Florida and fully insured, ensuring you receive expert care during your visit. As a professional establishment, we take pride in offering a safe and respectful environment for both guests and our entire team. 

 

Any inappropriate behavior, advances, or language during a session will result in the immediate termination of the service, and you will be held responsible for the full cost of the scheduled treatment.   

 

We reserve the right to refuse service to anyone to ensure a safe, respectful, and comfortable environment for both our guests and team. This allows us to maintain high standards of professionalism and to protect the well-being of everyone in our space.  

​

By making an appointment with Bodyworks of Perdido Key you agree to all the policies listed above.

Cleanliness Policies

At Bodyworks of Perdido Key, we prioritize the health and well-being of our guests and team. Maintaining a clean and sanitary environment is essential to providing a relaxing and safe spa experience. Our cleanliness policy is built on industry best practices, and our team has been certified in Infection Prevention and Control, ensuring the highest standards of hygiene and care. Our cleanliness practices include: 

​

Sanitation Between Guests:

Treatment tables, tools, and linens are thoroughly cleaned and replaced between each session.

All reusable tools are cleaned with hospital-grade disinfectants or sterilized after each use.

All facial sponges are single-use only and are never reused. Each facial guest receives a fresh, new sponge to ensure the highest level of cleanliness. 

​

Fresh Linens: 

​​​​​​Fresh linens and towels are used for every guest.

All linens, towels, and robes are laundered on-site and stored in a clean, dry environment to prevent contamination. 

We are unable to permit the use of any personal linens brought in by a guest in treatment, due to sanitation regulations. 


Hand Hygiene:

All providers are required to wash and sanitize their hands before and after each treatment.

​

Professional Cleaning Services: 

As part of our commitment to cleanliness, we have scheduled professional spa cleaning and maintenance services every week to ensure the entire space remains spotless and in top condition.

This thorough cleaning includes deep sanitization of all areas, ensuring that even the most frequently used spaces meet the highest cleanliness standards.

As part of our thorough cleaning practices, we also arrange for professional cleaning for all spa furniture and rugs on a quarterly basis. This deep cleaning ensures that the environment remains fresh and inviting for our guests, free from allergens and wear.  

​

We take great pride in the cleanliness and care of our spa space. We believe that a clean environment is essential to providing the ultimate relaxation and wellness experience for our guests. Every detail of our space reflects our commitment to hygiene and comfort, ensuring that when you step through our doors, you can feel at ease knowing you're in a safe, clean, and serene setting. Your well-being is our top priority, and we strive to create a space where you can truly relax.

Why it’s perfect for winter:




Hydrates dry skin: HydraFacial infuses your skin with intense hydration, perfect for combating winter dryness.




Brightens dull complexion: Exfoliation clears away dead skin cells, revealing your natural radiance.




Soothes sensitive skin: Gentle on even the most delicate skin, making it ideal for winter sensitivity.




Introducing the Hydralock HA Booster




We’re thrilled to add the Hydralock HA Booster to our HydraFacial lineup this winter. This cutting-edge serum is clinically proven to take hydration to a whole new level, giving your skin the love it deserves during the colder months.




Here’s what makes Hydralock HA Booster a game-changer:

24-hour hydration and flow: Your skin stays dewy and radiant all day long.

Targets winter woes: Say goodbye to dry patches and hello to smooth, glowing skin.




Think of it as a big drink of water for your skin—plus a little extra glow!

During your HydraFacial, we’ll tailor the treatment to your skin’s unique needs. With the Hydralock HA Booster, your skin will receive a surge of long-lasting hydration and rejuvenation. And for an elevated experience, when you book a Deluxe or Platinum HydraFacial you'll also receive a complimentary dermaplaning treatment, leaving your skin ultra - smooth and glowing. After just one session, you’ll notice:




Smoother, plumper skin.




Reduced fine lines and wrinkles.




A radiant, hydrated glow that feels as good as it looks.




And the best part? There’s no downtime—just immediate, beautiful results!




Why Your Winter Skin Deserves HydraFacial




Winter can be harsh, but your skin doesn’t have to show it. Treat yourself to a HydraFacial with the Hydralock HA Booster and enjoy:




A moment of relaxation and self-care.




Confidence in your hydrated, glowing skin.




The knowledge that you’re giving your skin the very best during the harshest season.

Winter Wellness: How Massage Can Help During Cold Season
bodyworksofperdido
Dec 11, 2024
2 min read





As the cold season sets in, many of us start to feel the effects of chilly weather and busy schedules. Stiff muscles, dry skin, low energy, and even seasonal sniffles can take a toll on our overall wellness. Thankfully, massage therapy offers a natural and soothing way to combat these challenges and keep you feeling your best throughout the winter months.




Here’s how massage can be your ultimate wellness ally this season:




1. Boosts Circulation and Warms the Body




Cold temperatures can slow down circulation, leaving you feeling stiff and achy. Massage helps stimulate blood flow, warming your muscles and joints and improving overall mobility. Our therapeutic Nature’s Healing Remedy massage harnesses the power of potent botanicals like arnica and stone crop, combined with the soothing warmth of basalt stones are especially effective for creating that cozy, relaxed feeling we all crave in winter. 

 

2. Strengthens the Immune System




Did you know regular massage can support your immune system? Massage therapy increases lymphatic flow, which helps flush toxins and boost your body’s natural defenses. This can be particularly helpful during cold and flu season, keeping you one step ahead of seasonal bugs.




3. Relieves Congestion and Supports Sinus Health




Massage techniques like lymphatic drainage or targeted facial massage can relieve sinus congestion and improve breathing. Our Breathe Easy massage enhancement is designed to ease facial tension and promote deep, restorative breathing. A touch of our therapeutic respiratory essential oil blend will help alleviate headaches, sinus pain, and tension while encouraging relaxation, and it’s a natural way to soothe stuffy noses and promote deep, refreshing breaths.




4. Eases Stress and Improves Sleep




The winter months often bring added stress—from holiday prep to darker days affecting our mood. Massage therapy is a proven stress reliever, reducing cortisol levels and boosting feel-good hormones like serotonin and dopamine. This relaxation can also improve your sleep quality, helping you wake up refreshed and ready to take on the day.




5. Hydrates Dry Winter Skin




Winter air can leave skin feeling dry and tight. Many massages incorporate nourishing oils or creams that deeply moisturize your skin while delivering therapeutic benefits. Treatments like a full-body massage with warmed oils with our Sole Revival massage enhancement can leave your skin soft and glowing.




6. Soothes Winter Aches and Pains




Cold weather can exacerbate muscle and joint pain, especially for those with arthritis or chronic conditions. Massage helps reduce inflammation and ease tension, providing relief from winter aches. Specialized techniques like deep tissue or CBD-infused massages are excellent options for targeted relief. A spa favorite here is our Deep Relief and CBD Chronic Gold Immersion Massage.




Treat Yourself to Winter Wellness




At Bodyworks of Perdido Key, we believe the cold season is the perfect time to prioritize self-care. Whether you’re looking to boost immunity, find relief from winter aches, or simply enjoy a moment of warmth and relaxation, our massage therapies are here to help.




This winter, give your body the care it deserves. Book your massage today and let us help you stay healthy and stress-free all season long.




Ready to embrace the healing power of massage this winter? Contact us to schedule your session!

Eminence Organic Skin Care products are hand-picked made with fresh fruit pulps, plants and exotic spices. This makes them incredibly rich in nutrients, so they are not only the healthiest choice for you, but also the most effective, results-oriented collection around.

 

Vitamins are captured in their all-natural fresh base, offering dramatic results as actual seeds, pulps and peels impart regenerative and healing powers that only nature can produce.

 

The precious ingredients are combined with thermal hot spring water to create products that contain potent healing and beautifying properties. Choosing organic ingredients ensures that there are no harsh chemicals added. Eminence products do not contain harmful chemicals like added Parabens, Petrolatum, Mineral Oils, Propylene Glycol or Sodium Lauryl Sulfate.

Each product used in your treatment will be selected based on your skin care needs and goals.

 

Your Licensed Esthetician will tailor your skin care treatment with personalized options, which may include LED Light Therapy and High Frequency. Each treatment customization is designed to maximize your results and ensure the most beneficial experience during your visit.

It’s also packed with Oleic acid (an omega-9 fatty acid) which is a key nutrient for dry and aging skin. Sourced from certified grassfed organic beef.

Beeswax Made from the honeycomb of honeybees, Beeswax creates a protective layer on the skin. Known as  a ‘humectant’ - which means that it holds water - Beeswax acts as a conditioning agent on the skin to promote skin regeneration, while also providing a protective barrier from mother nature's weather conditions.

​

Dead Sea Salt  Is a natural white crystal high in magnesium harvested from the Dead Sea in Israel. It helps improve and balance PH while hydrating, and reducing skin issues.

​

Cajeput Essential Oil  Derived from the Melaleuca leucadendron or the cajeput tree.  This essential oil can help alleviate exercise induced sore muscles, pain and skin inflammation.

Calendula The Calendula officinalis plant is known for promoting the production of collagen, Calendula gently soothes and nourishes the skin.

Enhance Your Home Wellness Routine with These Top Massage Tools
bodyworksofperdido
Dec 4, 2024
2 min read



Massage tools have become incredibly popular for maintaining wellness and relaxation at home. While nothing quite replaces the hands-on experience of a professional massage, massage tools can help relieve tension, improve circulation, and bring a little bit of spa-like comfort into your everyday routine. Here are some of our favorite massage tools to try between your spa visits!




1. Theragun or Percussive Therapy Devices




Percussive therapy devices, like the Theragun, deliver targeted pulses to muscles, releasing knots and relieving soreness. They’re particularly effective for athletes and those with tight muscles, as the tool reaches deeper layers of muscle tissue. Use it on major muscle groups like the back, shoulders, and legs for best results, but remember to start on a low setting if you’re new to percussive therapy.




2. Foam Rollers




Foam rollers are a classic for self-myofascial release, helping to release muscle tension and improve flexibility. These rollers work well on the legs, back, and hips, especially after workouts. For beginners, start with a softer foam roller to avoid discomfort, then gradually work up to firmer options for deeper release.




3. Massage Balls




Small but mighty, massage balls are perfect for targeting specific spots where tension tends to build, like between the shoulder blades or in the glutes. Available in various densities, these are excellent for DIY trigger point therapy and can help release tightness in hard-to-reach areas.




4. Foot Massagers




Foot massagers range from simple textured rollers to advanced heated, electric models. The feet contain pressure points connected to different areas of the body, so a quick foot massage can help release overall tension and restore balance. Plus, if you’re on your feet a lot, a foot massage can be wonderfully rejuvenating.




5. Heated Neck and Shoulder Massagers




These popular devices are designed to sit on your shoulders and deliver gentle, kneading motions to release neck and shoulder tension. Many come with heating features that provide extra relaxation, perfect after a long day at the computer or when you’re holding tension from stress.




Tips for Getting the Most Out of Your Massage Tools




Go Slow: Start with gentle pressure and short sessions, especially if you’re new to using massage tools.




Pair with Oils or Balms: Using essential oils, CBD balms, or massage lotions can enhance the experience, making tools glide smoothly over your skin.




Use Heat or Cold: Some tools pair well with heating or cooling pads to intensify the effects of your self-massage.




Stay Consistent: Regular use of massage tools can have long-term benefits for muscle health and relaxation, so aim for a few sessions each week.




At Bodyworks of Perdido Key, we’re always here to guide you in using these tools effectively. And remember, while these devices are fantastic for day-to-day relief, visiting your

massage therapist regularly provides the skilled, intuitive care that a machine simply can’t replace.
